title: Toolbar tools and their routes
text: Razor (C) = Add Edit; Ripple (B) / Roll (N) = Trim Edit + nudges; Rate Stretch (R) = `premiere_set_speed`; Slip (Y) / Slide (U) = their frame keys; Pen (P) = `set_param` keyframes; Track Select (A) = `select_clips` of every clip after a time; Type (T) = `place_text`. Hand / Zoom only move the view.
